title: Tiny, cute lemon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='lm' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff9a8'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffe23d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8b400'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- shadow glow under body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='26' ry='6' fill='#8a6500' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='27' ry='24' fill='url(#lm)'/>
  <!-- pointed lemon tips -->
  <path d='M23 60 Q14 66 16 74 Q24 70 27 66 Z' fill='#f2c200'/>
  <path d='M77 60 Q86 66 84 74 Q76 70 73 66 Z' fill='#f2c200'/>
  <!-- top tip -->
  <path d='M46 29 Q48 20 50 18 Q52 20 54 29 Z' fill='#f2c200'/>
  <!-- highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='42' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#fffde0' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- leaf -->
  <path d='M54 30 Q64 22 72 26 Q66 34 56 34 Z' fill='#4fc24a'/>
  <path d='M56 32 Q64 28 70 27 Q64 33 57 33 Z' fill='#8de88a'/>
  <!-- little eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='54' rx='4' ry='5.5' fill='#3a2a00'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='54' rx='4' ry='5.5' fill='#3a2a00'/>
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='52' r='1.6' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <circle cx='59.5' cy='52' r='1.6' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='62' rx='4.5' ry='3' fill='#ff9a3c' opacity='0.75'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='62' rx='4.5' ry='3' fill='#ff9a3c' opacity='0.75'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 63 Q50 69 55 63' stroke='#7a5800' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
